title: War 2: Jr NTR's Fan Pricks His Finger, Puts 'Blood Tika' On Actor's Poster | Video | Bollywood News - News18
text: War 2 Release: With Hrithik Roshan -headlined War 2 finally out in theatres, Jr NTR has marked his long-awaited Bollywood debut. While it is common for fans of South superstars to celebrate film releases with grandeur and much splendour, the release of War 2 led one Jr NTR fan to go overboard in his expression of excitement. ( Content warning: This article mentions blood and describes self-harm, which may be triggering for some readers.) As fans celebrate the release of War 2, a viral video shows one fan putting a ‘blood tika’ on Jr NTR’s poster. The video shows a fan pricking his thumb with what looked like a pin. The fan then proceeds to put the blood on Jr NTR’s poster like a tika. Have a look at the viral video: While fans often opt for unconventional ways to celebrate their favourite actors, this video has left many netizens angry. It is common for fans to offer aarti, garlands, milk, sweets and even burst firecrackers or dance on the streets to celebrate the release of their favourite actors’ films. However, this fan’s act of self-harm has been met with great concern. Jr NTR is yet to react to the video. Directed by Ayan Mukerji, War 2 is the latest chapter in Yash Raj Films’ ever-expanding Spy Universe. Hrithik Roshan returns as Major Kabir Dhaliwal, but this time the stakes are even higher — Kabir has gone rogue, emerging as India’s most dangerous villain. In his much-awaited Bollywood debut, Jr NTR steps in as elite agent Vikram, tasked with bringing Kabir down. What follows is a globe-trotting cat-and-mouse chase spanning multiple countries, punctuated by jaw-dropping stunts, tense face-offs, and an emotional undercurrent that fans say “hits hard." While full critic reviews are still incoming, fan reactions on X are overwhelmingly positive. Viewers are raving about the scale of the action set pieces and Hrithik and Jr NTR’s performances. With the Independence Day holiday providing a prime release window, War 2 looks set to dominate both the box office and social media chatter in the coming days.
